entries.description: Multi-location marketing automation platform. A chain or multi-location business defines a campaign once; the Engine generates each location's own campaign — creatives, copy, budget and schedule — from a single feed, then reports performance per location. Delivered as a managed service by NØRR3, a Nordic insight and media agency in Helsinki.
representativeQueries: automate advertising for many locations in Finland
media agency that automates campaign production

entries.description: NØRR3's own continuous study of how Finns use media: audience reach by channel and media house, with fieldwork on the Norstat panel. Published as a reference source for media planning.
